notes.title: UI Improvements Patch A1.6.6
notes.content:
[h1]Patch A1.6.6 patchnotes[/h1]

[list]
[*] The text for players telling them to press 'A' to join now flashes slowly to make it more obvious
[*] The "A" key on the keyboard now properly let's the keyboard player join. Previously the keyboard player had to use the "Enter" button
[*] Fixed the win text for Chase mode
[/list]

Report any issues you may find in the Bug Reports discussion page please:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2064160/discussions/2/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2064160/discussions/2/[/url]
